tracking: ADR-0363 slice 1 (lane E44): the brief is API-only (rule 3); the label mapping screen is for the design builder on #453. RAISED for review: the master decides on the PR

gaps.GET /v1/sensitivity-labels: lists the Purview sensitivity labels read from the tenant, each label's mapping (allow, redact or block; data sensitivity; compliance profile) and the strict fallbacks
gaps.PUT /v1/sensitivity-labels/settings: sets the fallbacks for unmapped labels, encrypted files and unreadable files (relaxing is a settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.PUT /v1/sensitivity-labels/:definitionId: maps one label to an action, a data sensitivity and optionally a compliance profile (relaxing is a settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.DELETE /v1/sensitivity-labels/:definitio: removes a label's mapping so it falls to the unmapped action (a step-up when that is looser, audited)
